answer: When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 8 times its size, so a group of 37 keys loses far more than 37 single identities would. The ocean graph is rebuilt each epoch, so that the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the ferrous audit merges it again. Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the terrace checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
